description.value: A sheltered cove campsite on Wallace Island Marine Provincial Park in the Gulf Islands, accessible only by boat or kayak from Chemainus; a stunning island destination that is completely off-limits to touring cyclists without water transport.

raw_osm.description: Numbered site each with a picnic table plus possible additional random sites in open grass field. Less suited for hammocks. Pit, vault toilets. No fires permitted. Food cache. Dining shelter.
raw_osm.description:landing: Easy on sand, pebble, rock in sheltered cove. Mud at low water. Alternate landing on E side of island 48D 56.283M N, 123D 32.650M W known locally as Honeymoon Bay. Short trail leads to camping area.
raw_osm.description:other: Historic buildings. Bring water - closest availability Montague Harbour Provincial Park, Dionisio Point Provincial Park. Hiking trails.
raw_osm.name: Conovoer Cove Campsite (BCMT)
raw_osm.reservation:description: Camping fees apply year-round. May pre-pay permit via Internet, but no reservable sites. Fee $5.00 per person per night (2019) via BC Parks Backcountry Registration System.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Primary evidence comes from OSM tags, as the fetched BC Parks website returned only navigation menus with no substantive park content. OSM tags confirm pit/vault toilets, a dining shelter, a food cache, and explicitly state that water is unavailable on-site (must be sourced from nearby parks). The OSM landing description makes clear this campsite on Wallace Island is accessible only by kayak or small boat, not by bicycle.
concerns: Name 'Conovoer Cove' appears to be a misspelling of 'Conover Cove' (the established name for this Wallace Island campsite) — OSM name preserved as-is per rules.
Campsite is on Wallace Island and is accessible only by kayak or small boat, not by bicycle; relevance to a cycling tourism directory is limited without a multimodal context.
Fetched BC Parks website returned only navigation content with no substantive park detail; all amenity data sourced solely from OSM tags.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, publicly accessible BC Parks backcountry campsite with confirmed infrastructure and an active fee registration system; water-only access limits direct cycling relevance but does not meet any exclusion criterion.
